privacy_observation_method: Observer records only sizes/MIME types/fixed-filename booleans. Audit endpoint probes real media/session HTTP routes via ASGITransport with the anonymous uploading session cookie held privately in helper memory; status/boolean results only are returned. Those probes are backend observations alongside actual UI actions, not browser navigation to hidden IDs.

media_events.scope: Six sampled muted play/playing/pause events, not a full sequencing or listening acceptance run.

tooling_notes: Initial file chooser+setFiles in a single call stalled for several minutes per upload. Opening the chooser and setting files in separate calls resolved this tooling delay; no app change.
One read-only DOM probe attempted an unavailable files property; selection evidence instead uses visible status, Clear state, actual screenshots and observed HTTP/provider behavior.
An attempted Pause after Skip was disabled because the queue correctly remained paused; observed state was used and no extra action was forced.

acceptance_scope.AT-10: Additional synthetic browser error/recovery evidence only; earlier real normal-launch evidence remains separately attributed.
acceptance_scope.AT-12: Reference non-exposure, fixed multipart filename and cleanup checks support browser/public-file safeguards; no general security certification.
acceptance_scope.AT-08: NOT PASSED here; real default/MP3/WAV speech comparison and human listening remain Mike's pending work.
acceptance_scope.AT-16: NOT RUN; this is not independent final ZIP installation.

reproduction: Create an unchanged credential-free checkout at the tested SHA; keep the manual helper/reports and fixtures separate. Do not copy .env or real recordings.
Use tests/test_references.py wav_bytes()/mp3_bytes() to make synthetic local fixtures outside Git; create empty, 22-byte malformed .wav and5,000,001-byte oversized files.

Run runtime_command in the locked environment. The reused audit_main_browser harness displays an OFFLINE banner, uses explicit synthetic settings/MockTransport and mutes audio; the extension guards DNS/connect against external destinations.
Use the actual chooser and existing sample queue controls for RP01-RP18. Browser chooser open and setFiles should occur in separate computer-use calls.

Inject only audit fixtures through POST /audit/control: bad_model true/false for the text failure, speech_fail true/false for the speech failure. Never replace actual provider settings or make class calls.

Read GET /audit/evidence and /audit/reference-evidence for safe counts, fixed filename booleans, memory totals and privacy probes. Do not log request bodies, cookies, private filenames, reference identifiers or bytes.
Compare counters around reload/cached replay, then close the temporary browser tab, stop only this audit process and verify its loopback port closes.
limitations: Synthetic UI regression on pinned main, not normal entrypoint/live provider acceptance.
No real reference clips, human voice comparison, audio listening, expiry or in-flight replacement race acceptance.
Class credentials were neither loaded nor checked; fake configured labels in screenshots are harness settings.
No production app, shared contracts, media, dependencies, CI, protection or assignment changes. #6/#8/#10 remain open and submission NOT READY.
